fullPassage: Who is this person? This is the question all stories ask. It emerges first at the ignition point. When the initial change strikes, the protagonist overreacts or behaves in an otherwise unexpected way. We sit up, suddenly attentive. Who is this person who behaves like this? The question then re-emerges every time the protagonist is challenged by the plot and compelled to make a choice. Everywhere in the narrative that the question is present, the reader or viewer will likely be engaged. Where the question is absent, and the events of drama move out of its narrative beam, they are at risk of becoming detached ― perhaps even bored. If there's a single secret to storytelling then I believe it's this. Who is this person? Or, from the perspective of the character, Who am I? It's the definition of drama. It is its electricity, its heartbeat, its fire.

✅ ③ attentive: We sit up을 보충 설명하는 형용사(주의 깊은)로 적절

✅ ④ engaged: will likely be engaged — 조동사 will + be 뒤의 과거분사(수동)로 적절
det.tip: 접속사절(When ~)에는 분사가 아니라 정동사가 필요: striking(X) → strikes(O)

✅ ① overreacts(과잉 반응하다): 변화가 닥치면 주인공이 '과잉 반응한다' — 원문 일치

❌ ② ignored(무시당하는) → challenged(시험받는): 주인공이 플롯에 의해 '시험받고(challenged)' 선택하도록 강요받는 맥락인데, '무시당한다(ignored)'면 선택을 강요받는 흐름과 모순됩니다 ←정답

✅ ③ present(존재하는): 질문이 '존재하는' 곳에서 독자가 몰입 — 원문 일치

questions.passage: Who is this person? This is the question all stories ask. It emerges first at the ignition point. When the initial change strikes, the protagonist overreacts or behaves in an otherwise unexpected way. We sit up, suddenly attentive. Who is this person who behaves like this? The question then re-emerges every time the protagonist is challenged by the plot and compelled to make a choice. Everywhere in the narrative that the question is present, the reader or viewer will likely be engaged. Where the question is absent, and the events of drama move out of its narrative beam, they are at risk of becoming detached ― perhaps even bored. If there's a single secret to storytelling then I believe it's this. Who is this person? Or, from the perspective of the character, Who am I? It's the definition of drama. <u>It is its electricity, its heartbeat, its fire</u>.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>It is its electricity, its heartbeat, its fire</u>가 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
밑줄의 It은 앞 문장의 '그 질문(Who am I? / Who is this person?)'을 가리키고, electricity(전기)·heartbeat(심장박동)·fire(불꽃)는 모두 '생명력·활력'을 나타내는 비유예요.

✅ ① 그 질문이 드라마에 생명력과 활력을 불어넣는 핵심 요소라는 것: 세 비유가 공통으로 가리키는 '살아 있게 하는 힘'과 일치 ←정답

❌ ② 강렬한 시각적 효과: 시각 효과 이야기가 아님

❌ ③ 위험한 힘: 전기·불을 '위험'으로 해석한 오답

❌ ④ 짧고 순간적: 소멸이 아니라 지속되는 생명력의 비유
